description: Probes a domain root for site-wide AI-discovery signals: /llms.txt; /robots.txt parsed per RFC 9309 for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, GoogleOther, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent (aiBotStatus is the verdict for the homepage path / only; aiBotDisallows lists rules that still block an allowed bot elsewhere); the sitemap (/sitemap.xml or robots.txt Sitemap lines, sitemap indexes followed, gzip read): urlCount is unique page URLs, urlCountComplete says whether every sitemap file was read; /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json, /.well-known/api-catalog, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json; and the homepage Link header. Every file reports found: true, false (checked and absent, including HTML catch-all pages), or null with checked:false (blocked, erroring or timed out: unknown).

domain.description: Root domain or full URL (e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com")

name: analyze_site
